title: Pet reaction close-up
prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 eye-level close-up of a golden retriever puppy on a sofa. Off-screen a squeaky toy sounds; the puppy tilts its head left, then right, ears perking up. Soft indoor afternoon light, cozy beige tones, static camera.
prompt_zh: 竖屏 9:16 平视特写，金毛幼犬在沙发上。画外传来玩具吱吱声，小狗先向左再向右歪头，耳朵竖起。柔和的室内午后光，温暖米色调，固定机位。
why_it_works: A small, sequenced action (left then right) is easier for models than complex motion and reads instantly on a phone screen.
variations: Cat version with a laser dot
